title: Introduce ephemeral-operator blindspot detector and CMK geofencing middleware
author: Lena Park
description:
Motivation: We observed two recurring compliance blindspots during readiness reviews for Dedicated/Private installs: (1) operator-scoped RBAC bindings that permit transient elevation via ephemeral operator leases, and (2) edge cases where customer-provided CMKs are used outside their declared region because of routing/failover. This PR introduces two defensive controls: an ephemeral-operator blindspot detector that flags potentially unobserved elevation windows and a lightweight CMK geofence middleware that enforces per-request CMK region alignment and emits structured audit watermarks.

Summary of changes: Adds a detector service and middleware and wires both into the private control plane. The detector evaluates RBAC v2 policy graphs and recent operator lease activity to produce risk signals; it also submits structured findings to the audit-forwarder. The CMK geofence middleware verifies the KMS key region (from key ARN/metadata) matches request's declared region and tenant residency constraints, rejecting requests or tagging them for manual review when mismatches are detected and no explicit cross-region-consent exists. Both features are behind a rollout feature flag (operator_blindspot_detector and cmk_geofence_enforce).

Behavioral notes: The blindspot detector runs asynchronously as a policy auditor with a default 5-minute lookback and a conservative severity mapping; it does not block requests. The CMK geofence middleware runs inline in the crypto allocator path and by default emits an audit-watermark header (X-Audit-Watermark) on mismatch events; when enabled with strict mode it will return 403 for cross-region CMK usage.

Checklist: - [x] Detector: policy graph walker + lease activity correlator implemented - [x] Middleware: CMK region resolver + enforcement and structured audit tags - [x] Feature flags with canary rollout support - [x] Unit tests (policy walker, resolver edge cases) - [x] Integration tests (end-to-end with private control plane test harness) - [x] Docs: admin guide + mitigation playbook - [x] Performance: inline middleware measured (p99 token overhead <2%)

Commits summary: see commit_summaries field below for high-level commit messages.

Files changed (high level): listed in changed_files field below; notable additions: services/operator_detector/, middleware/crypto/cmk_geofence.go, migration to add audit-watermark field to audit-forwarder payloads.

Review & discussion: Initial review requested by Marco (security owner). Priya requested tightening of severity thresholds and added a test for a 3rd-party KMS provider that returns minimal metadata. Ethan suggested emitting an allowlist for approved cross-region consents; implemented via tenant-level policy templates. CI originally had a flaky integration test (private-installer e2e) which was rerun and passed.

Risks & mitigations: Detector may yield false positives on short-lived leases; severity mapping is conservative and findings are routed to the audit queue rather than blocking. CMK middleware in strict mode can reject traffic; rolling out behind feature flags + canary mitigates blast radius.

Rollout plan: 1) Enable detector in non-blocking mode cluster-wide, monitor audit signals for 2 weeks. 2) Enable CMK geofence in monitoring-only mode (watermarks) for 1 week. 3) Gradually enable strict enforcement for Dedicated tenants with an explicit consent path.

Merge: squash-merged to main on 2025-12-03 after approvals and green CI.

release_notes: Adds an operator blindspot detector that surfaces potential ephemeral operator elevation windows and a CMK geofence middleware that enforces per-request CMK region alignment. Both are behind feature flags. No breaking changes.
